nodes.question: Comparing the source and edited images, has the identified book observably moved toward being behind the identified flower, and is it now behind it?
nodes.criteria: Compare the source and edited images, tracking the same book and flower. complete: the book is visibly behind the flower in the edited image. partial: the same book has observably moved toward the flower or into the behind relation, but is not yet behind it. absent: no observable movement of the identified book toward the identified flower's behind relation; mere repositioning elsewhere, object alteration/replacement, or changes to other objects do not count. unknown: object identity, movement, or depth ordering cannot be judged from the images.
nodes.binding: Target: the book identified in the source image; reference: the flower identified in the source image; requested relation: book behind flower.

program.checker_template: Execute exactly the supplied visual check on the source and edited images. Follow its saved binding, criteria and dependency evidence. Do not invent edits or infer an expected overall answer. Return JSON status, concise image-grounded evidence, and confidence (a number from 0 to 1, or null if unavailable). Confidence is your reported confidence in this check's observation, not a calibrated probability. A requested fulfillment check uses complete/partial/absent/unknown. A support check uses pass/fail/unknown. A known negative supporting observation can inform a requested check; it is not automatically uncertainty. Use unknown when the evidence cannot establish the requested fact. Do not count supporting facts as completed edits. Assess only the supplied check, not the overall instruction label.
